reserveReview.rationale: Refresh 2026-08-28: Goldfish identifies ION.au as GGBR's direct reserve instrument and designates Ethereum wallet 0x2F371Ba19F89874689a91bA322194F9967Cb640D as the collateral wallet. Pinned Ethereum RPC reads at block 25849423 on 2026-08-27T22:02:23Z returned 25,000 ION.au in that wallet and 25,000,000 GGBR total supply, exactly one ION.au per 1,000 GGBR and consistent with the disclosed direct-backing ratio. The evidence remains assets-only: it does not independently attest the underlying gold quantity or reconcile contractual liabilities.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Official Goldfish collateral model reconciled to exact Ethereum balances at block 25849423
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The direct reserve instrument and its on-chain quantity are resolved. ION.au's underlying in-situ gold claims, legal enforceability, and off-chain custody remain upstream instrument-quality risks rather than an unidentified GGBR reserve slice.
